## 📋 **Overview**

This directory contains comprehensive API documentation for all engine modules, components, and systems.

## 🔧 **Generating Documentation**

```bash
# Generate API documentation
py2d-build docs --api

# Generate specific module docs
py2d-build docs --module graphics

# Generate and serve locally
py2d-build docs --serve
```
